title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.8.13
text: 📻 A boombox or TV that can't play its link now says so, with the reason, instead of staying silent. Most often it's a song whose uploader only lets it play on YouTube itself (many official music videos): a "lyrics" or "Topic" upload of the same song usually works, or an mp3 link.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.8.12
text: 🗺️ Map TVs and boomboxes: room admins place them in the map editor (Functional items, with the SCE icon). Click one: admins set its link, play, pause, turn it off and set how far it's heard; everyone can hide it for themselves or watch a TV full screen. Its link stays with the room's map, also through /mapcopy and /mappaste. Players without SCE see an empty tile. Settings > SCE > 📺 Players can turn them all off. 📻 The boombox's music now has its time bar (on its own row: it had no room).

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.8.11
text: 📻 Boombox (Held items): carried by its handle, it plays a music file (.mp3, .ogg, .wav) or a YouTube link's sound for the whole room, in sync, like the TV: pause, seek, its own volume, Listen / Always / Never. 🗺️ In map rooms TVs and boomboxes are heard within a range (10 tiles to start, fading out at the edge); their owner sets it in the item's menu, up to the whole map. ⚙️ All TV and boombox options are on one page: Settings > SCE > 📺 Players.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.8.10
text: 🐛 Fixed: TVs went quiet on and off while you were in another tab; they now play on untouched. 📌 The floating TV window has the room chat beside the video, like full screen (💬 hides it).

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.8.9
text: 🐛 Fixed: YouTube TVs floating over every tab (📌) showed YouTube's "Error 153" instead of playing. Pinning from full screen now closes full screen, so closing the floating window brings the TV back to the room.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.8.8
text: 📺 Like a video player: click a TV's picture to pause or play it (for everyone, if you may change that TV), double click for full screen and again to leave it. Works while its controls show, so other clicks still reach the room.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.8.7
text: 🎨 The TV's buttons, bar, questions and full-screen chat take Themed's colours when you use it, or follow your BC chat theme (light or dark) when you don't. The chat lines look as they do in your own chat.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.8.6
text: 🐛 Fixed: with WCE, talking from the full-screen TV chat left a faded ghost copy of each line in the room chat. Ghosts already there go away when you reload.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.8.5
text: 📺 Watch a TV your way, only for you: ⧉ pops it out into a small player you drag anywhere and size by its corner, and 📌 floats it over every tab and program in its own window (Chrome, Edge, Opera). Both keep playing in sync while you look at a profile, open a menu or walk around the map. Closing is one click: the red ✕ in its corner (always showing), or a double click. 💬 Full screen now shows the room's chat beside the video, like a stream's live chat: the real chat, and you can talk from it (drag its edge to make it wider; 💬 hides it).

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.8.4
text: 🤢 Sick face: a green, queasy face in the Blush row of the expression menu. 🎭 Two new activities on the arms: Tickle Armpit and Lick Armpit.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.8.3
text: 📺 TV sound of its own: each person's TV has its own volume slider on its bar (just for you), starting at the base TV volume in SCE's settings, 30% to begin with. It no longer follows the game's sound volume.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.8.2
text: 📺 TVs got real player controls: they show while your mouse moves over a TV and hide after. ⏸ pauses and ▶ plays for everyone in the room, and the time bar jumps to any part of the video for everyone (for whoever may change that TV). Full screen has all of them too. Joining a room pauses your TV for everyone, so the room has time to react; press ▶ to play it. TVs of players on your blacklist or ghost list never show for you. TVs now work in map rooms: small over each character, with ⛶ to watch full screen.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.8.1
text: 📺 TVs are opt-in: someone else's TV plays nothing for you until you press ▶ Watch on it (asked again in each room), or choose Always or Never for that person; switch this off in SCE's settings to see every TV. ⏻ on a TV turns it off or on for everyone (if you may change it). TVs stay in sync: every few seconds each TV checks it is where everyone else's is (on the game server's clock) and catches up if it fell behind or stopped. Watch a TV full screen with the ⛶ in its corner (the small ✕ or Esc closes it), mute one TV just for you with its 🔊, or hide all TVs just for you with its 🙈 (or in its menu, or SCE's settings). And no more console errors from YouTube TVs.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.8.0
text: 📺 New HD TV (Misc items): paste a YouTube link or a link to a video file (.mp4, .webm) in its menu and it plays for everyone in the room with SCE, all from the same moment. Make it bigger or smaller and move it from the same menu; turn the TV sound off for yourself there too.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.7.0
text: ⚔️ New Jedi and Sith outfits: the Jedi, Sith, Jedi Knight, Sith War, Jedi Armoured and Jedi Ranger Tunics (Clothes), with Jedi and Sith Trousers and Leggings and the Jedi Armoured and Ranger Trousers (Lower Clothes). Every part its own colour, every chest and hip size. A few poses are still to come for some of them.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.6.2
text: 🧶 Sleeves: the school tops and Miko Top are back to how they were before the cuffs, and the gap between arm and waist is open again (a small one on the Miko). ⚙ Settings: new Contribute, Credits and To BC devs pages, and a link to SCE's repo page.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.6.0
text: 👕 Extra slots: a second Upper Clothing, Outerwear, Lower Clothing, Clothing Accessory, Suit (Upper and Lower), Bra, Panties, Socks, Shoes, Gloves, Hat, Necklace and Body Markings, marked with the SCE logo at the end of the wardrobe, so you can wear two of each, other add-ons' clothes (Echo's too) included. Turn them off in the SCE settings. 🤝 SCE is open to contributors: how to send clothes, activities or fixes is on the repo page (CONTRIBUTING.md).

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.5.3
text: 🧶 Sleeve fix: the Sailor Top, School Blazer, School Cardigan and Miko Top now have cuffs over the wrists when standing, so the hands come out of the sleeves instead of lying on top of them. ⚔️ Lightsaber: new Slash, aimed at any body part, plus Rub and Spank like other sticks.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.5.2
text: 👘 Kimono fix: with other hands (another add-on's, or moved), no more skin showing through the kimono around the hands, sleeveless included.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.5.1
text: 🧥 Layering fix: jackets, coats and necklaces worn over the Miko Top, Hakama and school uniforms now cover them in every pose, as they do standing.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.5.0
text: 🎒 New school uniforms: the Sailor Top, the School Blazer and the School Cardigan (Upper Clothing), and a Pleated Skirt (Lower Clothing) to wear with any of them.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.4.0
text: ⚔ New: the Lightsaber (Held items), blade, hilt and grip in your own colours. Hold it and feel the Force.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.3.1
text: ⛩ Miko fixes for fit makers: moving, resizing or relayering the Miko Top and Hakama no longer opens holes around your hands, and taped hands show in front.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.3.0
text: ⛩ New: the Gohei, a shrine maiden's wand (Held items). Hold it and see what it can do.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.2.1
text: ⛩ Hakama fixes: it now sits right when kneeling with legs spread, and nothing shows through around your hands.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.2.0
text: ⛩ New: the Miko Top (in Upper and Outer Clothing) and the Hakama (Lower Clothing), a shrine maiden outfit in white and red, every colour your own.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.1.0
text: 👘 New Kimono style: Short. Pick it in the Kimono's Style options.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v1.0.0
text: SCE 1.0! New in SCE's settings: a Clothing list and an Activity list, to see everything SCE adds. The SCE badge and the mark above SCE users always show now.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.9.4
text: 🐉 New Kimono pattern: Dragon. It winds down the skirt in every size, sleeve choice and pose; pick it in the Kimono's Pattern options.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.9.3
text: Fixes: the SCE badge shows on item tiles again; Esc closes SCE's settings page; someone without SCE can now put a top on you in place of the kimono; switching the activities off no longer changes how others' activities feel; small clean-ups.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.9.2
text: ♻ Crafts of SCE items are safe now: if the game drops them because SCE loaded late, SCE keeps a copy and puts them back (or asks first: Preferences > Extensions > Slime Clothing Extension).

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.9.0
text: 🎭 37 new activities in the activity menu, each with the SCE badge (players without SCE still read them in chat; switch them off in SCE's settings). 👘 The Kimono now has pictures for every pose, all fours and hogtied included.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.8.3
text: Kimono poses: hands cuffed behind the back now has its own pictures, with every sleeve, pattern and obi choice. Cleaner elbows on the raised-arm poses.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.8.2
text: Kimono poses: yoked (arms out, forearms up) and elbows touching behind the back now have their own pictures, with every sleeve, pattern and obi choice. Sleeves in raised poses show their lining only along the inner edge.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.8.1
text: Kimono poses: arms raised over the head (the sleeves slide down to the elbows like real cloth) and taped hands, with every sleeve, pattern and obi choice. Detached sleeves and sleeveless now fully cover big busts in every pose.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.8.0
text: Kimono poses: the Kimono now stays on with the hands behind the back (box tie and elbows touching), with every sleeve choice, pattern and obi choice. More poses are coming.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.7.1
text: Kimono with No obi: the waist is now the kimono's own fabric, its lines and folds, instead of a flat block in the obi's shape. With the obi on nothing changes.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.7.0
text: Fixed: the game kept old copies of SCE's pictures saved in your browser and never updated them, so after an update some parts could still show an older look (mismatched layers, gaps in the pattern). SCE now clears its old pictures once after each update and lets the game check them properly.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.6.9
text: The separate Furisode item is gone; the Kimono is SCE's kimono.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.6.8
text: Kimono: the long-sleeve kimono is back to its original pictures. The obi choice is now one: With obi / No obi, and No obi takes off the obi and its cord together.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.6.7
text: Kimono with long sleeves: the body now has the same pattern as the sleeveless kimono; the sleeves keep theirs.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.6.6
text: Kimono and Furisode: the obi and its cord share one colour row (use its arrows to pick the obi or the cord), so the Kimono's colours fit on one page. The Kimono's patterns are back to how they were before 0.6.4.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.6.5
text: Kimono: new Obi choice. "No obi" takes off the obi and its cord.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.6.4
text: Kimono: an outfit saved before the sleeve and collar choices existed now shows its sleeves' edges and collar again (the pattern no longer pokes out past the outline). Hiding the obi now shows the kimono and its pattern under it instead of a plain block.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.6.3
text: New: the SCE mark. In chat rooms, SCE users show a small SCE icon above their character, right of ER's, with their SCE version when you point at it. You can turn it off in SCE's settings.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.6.2
text: Furisode: with the obi cord off, the obi is now plain obi fabric where the bow was, with no trace of the bow's shape left.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.6.1
text: Furisode: taking the obi cord off now removes all of it, bow and outline included, and leaves a clean obi. On the Small chest size the whole cord now takes the cord colour.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.6.0
text: New: Furisode, a long kimono drawn as one piece and split into colour parts (kimono, sakura, lining, collar, obi, obi cord), each with its own colour, for every chest size. The obi and its cord can be taken off. The old kimono is still there.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.5.2
text: The kimono is back to its earlier look while a better-made one is drawn. Colours you picked on either version stay on the right parts.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.5.0
text: The kimono is rebuilt the way hand-drawn clothes are made: every part is a complete layer (the obi is whole under the cord, lining and collar sit under the kimono), shading and lines are their own layers so any colour keeps its shading, and it covers every body including Echo V2. Shading, highlight and lines have their own colours too.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.4.1
text: The kimono is back to the 0.3.0 version while a better-made one is drawn.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.4.0
text: The kimono is redrawn: detached sleeves and sleeveless are now drawn versions with proper armholes and a sleeve band, the obi is drawn whole under the cord (turn the cord off cleanly), every part's edge follows the drawing, and the obi cord and pattern outline share rows in the colour screen so every colour fits on one page.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.3.0
text: Your SCE clothes come back if the game dropped them while loading: SCE keeps a copy with your account and puts them back into empty slots. There's also a button for it in Preferences > Extensions.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.2.1
text: The kimono fits Echo's body styles (V1 and V2) at the shoulders too.

title: Slime Clothing Extension v0.2.0
text: The kimono now has proper names everywhere, one whole layer per colour, a tile picture, the SCE badge on our clothes, and a settings page in Preferences > Extensions. You'll be told when an update is ready.
